summary.text: Bruce Sassmann is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 61, who assumed office on January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Sassmann has owned and operated a convenience store.

paragraphs.text: Bruce Sassmann was born in Washington, Missouri, and graduated from Bland High School in 1968.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri State University in 1973 and an associate degree in funeral service from St. Louis Community College at Forest Park in 1981.
Sassmann's career experience includes owning and operating a convenience store.

In the Missouri House, Sassmann was assigned to the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee, the Conservation and Natural Resources Committee, where he was vice chair, and the Rural Economic Development committee for 2025-2026.
He chaired the Conservation and Natural Resources Committee in 2023-2024.
